fusions.name: Clinging Maul
fusions.desc: Clamps onto a target's back and mauls it with a weapon strike for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Bough-Breaker
fusions.desc: Leaps and lands with your full weight, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Thick Pelt, Light Step
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 18% for 12 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Prodded Too Often
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
